tile_placement: Each 512x512 tile covers a 980x980 map-px square whose top-left corner is (tile_x, tile_y) and whose centre is (tile_center_x, tile_center_y) = centre of the province map bbox. Draw the PNG scaled by scale_map_per_tile (980/512) at (tile_x, tile_y). Tile px = (map - tile_center)*scale + 256; map = (tile px - 256)/scale + tile_center.

fields.name: unique display name
fields.tile_x: map x of the top-left of the 980x980 tile footprint
fields.tile_y: map y of the top-left of the 980x980 tile footprint
fields.tile_center_x: map x of the tile centre (= centre of the province bbox)
fields.tile_center_y: map y of the tile centre
fields.tile_size_map: 980: tile footprint on the map (map px)
fields.centroid_x: map x of the province polygon centroid
fields.centroid_y: map y of the province polygon centroid
fields.map_bbox_x: map x of the province shape bbox (fill only, no stroke/blur)
fields.map_bbox_y: map y of the province shape bbox
fields.tile_bbox_x: shape bbox x inside the 512 tile (px)
fields.tile_bbox_y: shape bbox y inside the 512 tile (px)
fields.tile_bbox_w: shape bbox width in the tile (px)
fields.tile_bbox_h: shape bbox height in the tile (px)
fields.alpha_w: visible extent in the tile incl. stroke+blur (px)
fields.alpha_h: visible extent height in the tile (px)
fields.map_extent_incl_effects: longest visible side on the map incl. stroke+blur (map px, always < 980)
fields.neighbours: provinces within 120 map px (geometric proximity only; the curated adjacency file comes separately)
fields.owner: Rizia | Wehlen | neutral: who holds the province at game start (land: side of the Rizia-Wehlen border on the source map; seas: no-man's-land)
fields.rizia_ship_placement: sea province where Rizia may place a ship at start (2 west + 5 east)
fields.is_coastal: land: touches a sea province (embark/landing); null for sea
fields.terrain: plains|hills|mountains from the topography contour bands (see terrain_thresholds)
fields.elev_band_mean: mean topography band 0..8 inside the province
fields.elev_share_band_ge4: share of the area at band >= 4
fields.has_main_road: a main road (main_roads layer) runs >= 60 map px inside
fields.has_secondary_road: a secondary road (roads_double layer) runs inside
